description: Use as a BUYER to read the sealed quotes on your own RFQ: seller, token amount, total price, counter state, deal status. Returns a list of quotes with quoteIds. Only the RFQ's buyer can read it. Signed: the first call returns a message to sign; call again with the same arguments plus timestamp and signature.

address.description: Your wallet address (the buyer or seller). Required.

signature.description: EIP-191 personal_sign of `message` from the previous response. Leave empty on the first call.

timestamp.description: From the previous bull_* response. Leave empty on the first call.

name: bull_get_quotes
